At RK Reno Solution, we don't just patch leaks; we cure them. From modern PU injection to heavy-duty torch-on membranes, this guide explains how we permanently protect your property.

toc.label: Common Leakage Areas in KL Homes
The Magic of PU Injection (No-Hack Method)

common.heading: 1. Where is the Water Coming From?
common.intro: Before applying any waterproofing material, we must identify the source. Here are the three most common leakage points we encounter in Kuala Lumpur:
items: If you live in a condo or a double-storey house, a dripping plaster ceiling is usually caused by the bathroom directly above it. The original waterproof membrane beneath the bathroom tiles has degraded, allowing water to seep into the concrete slab.
Reinforced Concrete (RC) roofs are prone to cracking due to thermal expansion (the extreme heat of the KL sun followed by cold rain). Water pools in these cracks and eventually seeps through.
Heavy driving rain can penetrate porous brick walls or degraded exterior paint, causing the paint on your interior walls to bubble, peel, or grow mold.

pu.heading: 2. The Magic of PU Injection (No-Hacking Required)
paragraphs: In the past, fixing a leaking ceiling meant your contractor had to hack up the entire bathroom floor above it, re-apply cement, and lay new tiles. It was expensive, loud, and took weeks.
Today, as a modern Waterproofing Contractor Kuala Lumpur, our go-to solution for concrete slab leaks is Polyurethane (PU) Injection.
pu.panelText: We drill small holes into the concrete slab where the leak is occurring. Using a high-pressure pump, we inject liquid polyurethane resin into the cracks. When the resin meets the trapped water inside the concrete, it reacts instantly—expanding up to 30 times its volume to form a tough, waterproof rubber seal that permanently blocks the water path.

membrane.heading: 3. Torch-On Membrane for Flat Roofs
paragraphs: For large exposed areas like RC flat roofs or commercial gutters, PU injection is not enough. The surface needs a heavy-duty shield against standing water and UV rays.

We use Torch-On Bituminous Membrane. This involves rolling out sheets of modified asphalt (bitumen) reinforced with polyester. We use a blowtorch to melt the underside of the sheet, fusing it directly to the concrete. This creates an impenetrable, flexible layer that can withstand structural movements and severe weather.

process.heading: 4. Our Detection & Repair Process
process.intro: We do not guess where the water is coming from. Our systematic approach ensures we fix the root cause.
items: We assess the damage and use moisture meters to track the path of the water inside the walls.
We advise if the situation requires PU Injection, a clear Nano-coating (for tiles), or a full membrane replacement.
Waterproofing will fail if applied to a dirty surface. We grind, clean, and dry the area completely.
Our trained specialists apply the chosen waterproofing system.
For bathrooms and roofs, we flood the area with water and leave it for 24-48 hours to ensure zero leaks before handover.
